provenance.data: Human Phenotype Ontology release 2026-06-23 (phenotype.hpoa, genes_to_disease.txt, hp.obo)
provenance.determinism: seed=42; deterministic sparse linear algebra; symbol tie-breaks; permutation via numpy default_rng; payload sha over sorted-key JSON excluding verdict/provenance
provenance.method: IC-weighted cosine over ancestor-propagated HPO term vectors; gene profiles built leave-one-disease-out (test disease's own annotation removed from its causal genes); frequency-prior = LODO pleiotropy degree; random = analytic + permutation null

verdict: PASS — a validated phenotype-INPUT retrieval front door extending the 'any disease' input modality into the genetic arms. Over 4436 held-out diseases (LODO, leakage-controlled), IC-weighted HPO phenotype overlap recovers the true causal gene in the top-10 at recall@10=0.529 (MRR=0.357) vs a frequency-prior popularity null of recall@10=0.026 (MRR=0.014) — a +0.503 margin, paired Wilcoxon p=0.0e+00, and above the random-permutation null (p=1.0e-04). The pre-registered abstention rule (51.5% abstained) is well-targeted: abstained profiles would score only recall@10=0.330 vs 0.529 on scored. Holds on the MENDELIAN subset (recall@10=0.431). SCOPE: RETRIEVAL over KNOWN HPO→gene associations (validated lookup+ranking), NOT de-novo mechanism inference for a never-seen phenotype (OPEN, explicitly not attempted). Identifies CANDIDATE genes to hand off to MENDEL1/GENETICS1; does not validate them or produce therapy (affinity wall stands). HONEST BOUND: 729/4436 scored diseases have a causal gene seen in NO other disease (empty LODO profile) → unrecoverable in principle, counted as misses.
